title: Dose details are collected only when the intervention occurred (CORE-000004 / CORE-000137)
description: Dose fields (--DOSE, --DOSTXT, --DOSU, --DOSFRQ, --DOSTOT) with a same-domain --OCCUR field are shown only when Occurred = Yes (that field's own Yes code), unless they already have a relevant.
rationale: CDISC CORE-000004 / CORE-000137: dose must not be populated when --OCCUR = 'N'. Hiding dose fields when the intervention did not occur prevents the inconsistency at entry.
